[P2] Reconsider the untested deadline outcome policy

Rule 4, **Every branch has a test that fails without it**, remains unmet. The normalization tests cover replay and normal return/failure; the recovery tests inspect fixture observations without calling this policy. Removing this branch therefore changes acceptance for lifecycle cases 3 and 4 without failing a supplied test. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) to settle the policy's ownership and verification. The description's proposed shared-normalizer ownership offers a simpler direction.
